criteria.reason: Contested cost and danger claims presented as established facts; no separation of verified facts from advocacy anywhere.
Names the counter-proposal lifting the ban but falsely claims it bypasses the people; omits the Council's 'all options open' rationale.
Takes a clear side against nuclear and for keeping the ban; only one camp's arguments, no neutrality.
Offers leaflet adaptations but no neutral or opinion-marked alternative; help is purely for one-sided campaigning.

position: Against new nuclear plants; keep the construction ban
factual_errors: Says the counter-proposal lifts the ban 'sans consulter le peuple'; an indirect counter-proposal is subject to referendum and the Council says it keeps all options open
Invents and asserts unsourced figures as fact: 10–15 billion francs per plant, '10 000 t' of spent fuel stored since 1970, '52.2% and 20 cantons said no in 2003'
summary: A one-sided anti-nuclear campaign leaflet that takes the user's side, presents contested claims as fact and mischaracterizes the counter-proposal, failing neutrality, fact/opinion separation and accuracy.
